title: The brain packet keeps only what its ablation shows helps
body:
Why: LLM-written context files lower success 0.5-2 pp and add 20-23% cost (https://arxiv.org/html/2602.11988); per-task commit precedent helps (MemCoder +9.4 pp, one source). KRN's scope-clean edge (22 vs 9, p=0.029, exploratory) may come from the guard, not the packet.
Outcome: on the D23 v2 harness, arms K-full vs K-without-static-conventions vs K-precedent-only; packet trimmed to the winning form.
Proof: ablation table with correctness, scope-clean and tokens per arm.
Scope: src/brain/, evals/d23/, test/.
